$comment: The functions an integration implements, and core calls. Mentions of them link to the page on this site that explains them, with a card. Every signature is quoted from the file in its `quote`: `pnpm symbols` checks that it is still there. See "Code symbols" in README.md.

async_setup.when: Home Assistant calls it once when it loads your integration, before it sets up any config entry.

signatures.signature: async def async_setup(hass: HomeAssistant, config: ConfigType) -> bool:

async_setup_entry.when: Home Assistant calls it for every enabled config entry when it starts, and right away when a user adds an entry, and each platform you forward the entry to gets its own.

signatures.signature: async def async_setup_entry(hass: HomeAssistant, entry: ExampleConfigEntry) -> bool:
async def async_setup_entry(hass: HomeAssistant, entry: ExampleConfigEntry, async_add_entities: AddConfigEntryEntitiesCallback) -> None:

async_unload_entry.when: Home Assistant calls it when a user reloads, disables, or deletes a config entry.

signatures.signature: async def async_unload_entry(hass: HomeAssistant, entry: ExampleConfigEntry) -> bool:

async_remove_entry.when: Home Assistant calls it after a user deletes a config entry, when the entry is already gone.

signatures.signature: async def async_remove_entry(hass: HomeAssistant, entry: ExampleConfigEntry) -> None:

async_migrate_entry.when: Home Assistant calls it before setup when the version of a stored config entry differs from the version of your config flow.

signatures.signature: async def async_migrate_entry(hass: HomeAssistant, entry: ExampleConfigEntry) -> bool:

async_remove_config_entry_device.when: Home Assistant calls it when a user deletes a device in the UI, and only removes the device when it returns True.

signatures.signature: async def async_remove_config_entry_device(hass: HomeAssistant, entry: ExampleConfigEntry, device_entry: DeviceEntry) -> bool:

async_setup_platform.when: Home Assistant calls it to set up a platform from YAML, or one that an integration loads with async_load_platform.

signatures.signature: async def async_setup_platform(hass: HomeAssistant, config: ConfigType, async_add_entities: AddEntitiesCallback, discovery_info: DiscoveryInfoType | None = None) -> None:

signatures.signature: async def async_get_config_entry_diagnostics(hass: HomeAssistant, entry: ExampleConfigEntry) -> dict[str, Any]:

async_get_device_diagnostics.when: Home Assistant calls it when a user downloads the diagnostics of a device.

signatures.signature: async def async_get_device_diagnostics(hass: HomeAssistant, entry: ExampleConfigEntry, device: DeviceEntry) -> dict[str, Any]:
